purpose: record and repair the band-constructor defect that produced the non-monotone ladder in diagnostic_scaling_bands_b.json
status: PRE-WORK INSTRUMENT, doc 54's instrument exception. Bound calculator, not an experiment. No exp76 experiment code exists.

provenance.null_not_recomputed: cited from diagnostic_scaling_bounds.json; bands_b asserted it reproduces to 1e-12

the_defect.code: per = [size // k + (1 if i < size % k else 0) for i in range(k)]
the_defect.effect: the remainder size % k is assigned to the FIRST runs, front-loading bearer density around the circle
the_defect.verdict: CONFIRMED: the rebound is a construction artefact. The balanced control removes it at every arc count, and the front/back mass ratio tracks it (1.025 -> 1.455 -> 1.531).

mechanism.decomposition: x^T A y = w . (u_b x u_n); R1 (w=(1,0,0)) is an angular-ORDER rule, R2 (w=(0,w2,w3)) is a SINUSOID-COMPARISON rank statistic
mechanism.reading: R2 tracks the full bound through the rebound region while R1 stays near 0.52, so the inflation is the sinusoid-comparison family exploiting the density gradient -- which is what a '2-arc' half-plane rule is in this basis

band_016arc_balanced.method: CONSTRUCTIVE LOWER BOUND (48 restarts x 500 steps + 6 LS-drop starts); the EXACT R^3 arrangement enumeration is O(n_rows^3) and is INFEASIBLE at this inventory size

saturation_certificate.note: doc 61 SS2.4's certificate fires iff rank(G) == n_rows. At d_joint = 9 the rank is at most 9, so it CANNOT fire at this inventory size and the grade-1 instrument DISCRIMINATES.

null_reference.why_percentile_is_null: the 200 null draws are not recomputed here; bands_b already asserted they reproduce to 1e-12, and an ESTIMATED percentile would be a different quantity from the measured ones
